title: Man in Zamboanga del Sur nabbed for P5.78-M smuggled cigarettes
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) arrested a 38-year-old man in Zamboanga del Sur on Wednesday in connection with the suspected P5.78 million worth of smuggled cigarettes.…
